instruction.text: Shiloh is taking part in a go-kart race. The course is 3 `km` long and he has to complete 7 rounds of the course. Work out how many kilometres he travels in total.
instruction.sound: Shiloh is taking part in a gokart race. The course is 3 kilometres long and he has to complete 7 rounds of the course. Work out how many kilometres he travels in total.

instruction.text: Priti and Aria are both practising long jump. Priti jumps 289 `cm` and Aria jumps 21 `cm` further. Work out how far Aria jumps.
instruction.sound: Priti and Aria are both practising long jump. Priti jumps 289 centimetres and Aria jumps 21 centimetres further. Work out how far Aria jumps.

instruction.text: Tom is 1.60 `m` tall. His younger brother Matt is 30 `cm` shorter. Work out how tall Matt is.
instruction.sound: Tom is 1 metre 60 tall. His younger brother Matt is 30 centimetres shorter. Work out how tall Matt is.

atoms.a: Next, subtract their height difference from Tom’s height.
Finally, convert Tom’s height back into metres.

instruction.text: Saoirse and Rakesh went on a cycling holiday. On Friday, they cycled 24 `km` and on Saturday, they cycled 28 `km`. Calculate how far they cycled altogether on these two days.
instruction.sound: Sersha and Rakesh went on a cycling holiday. On Friday, they cycled 24 kilometres and on Saturday, they cycled 28 kilometres. Calculate how far they cycled altogether on these two days.

atoms.a: To get back home on Sunday, they took a shortcut. The shortcut was 19 `km` shorter than the total distance they had cycled on Friday and Saturday combined. How far did they cycle on Sunday?
atoms.sound: To get back home on Sunday, they took a shortcut. The shortcut was 19 kilometres shorter than the total distance they had cycled on Friday and Saturday combined. How far did they cycle on Sunday?

atoms.a: How far did they cycle in total on their holiday?
